steps.sameUI: async(port,path,removeToken=false)=>{await permits.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${path}`); await permits.getAXState(); if(removeToken){const doc=await pc.send('DOM.getDocument');const token=await pc.send('DOM.querySelector',{nodeId:doc.root.nodeId,selector:'input[name="__RequestVerificationToken"]'});await pc.send('DOM.removeNode',{nodeId:token.nodeId});} await permits.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'Submit permit',exact:true}).click();await permits.getAXState();const r={sourcePort:port,path,removeToken,...(await navResult())};formReceipts.push(r);return r;}
steps.crossUI: async(sourcePath,targetPath)=>{await permits.goto('http://localhost:6019'+sourcePath); await permits.getAXState(); const doc=await pc.send('DOM.getDocument'); const form=await pc.send('DOM.querySelector',{nodeId:doc.root.nodeId,selector:'form'}); await pc.send('DOM.setAttributeValue',{nodeId:form.nodeId,name:'action',value:'http://127.0.0.1:6013'+targetPath}); await permits.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'Submit permit',exact:true}).click(); await permits.getAXState(); const result={source:'http://localhost:6019'+sourcePath,target:'http://127.0.0.1:6013'+targetPath,...(await navResult())}; formReceipts.push(result); return result;}

limits: CDP origin scoping drops cross-origin network headers. Empty HTTP 400 pages can appear as ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT; Kestrel result lines are saved separately. Only form action/token DOM in disposable local pages was changed; navigation resets these changes.
